name: Dove Exfoliating Body Scrub Pomegranate Seeds 225ml / Macadamia & Rice Milk Scent 225ml / Body Polish Brown Sugar & Coconut Butter 298gm / Oatmeal & Calendula Oil 298gm | Made in Slovakia
description:
Dove Exfoliating Body Scrub – Pomegranate Seeds, 225ml

Indulge your skin with Dove Exfoliating Body Scrub Pomegranate Seeds, a gentle body exfoliator that removes dull, dry skin while restoring your skin’s natural nutrients. Enriched with ¼ moisturising cream, it deeply nourishes for a soft, smooth feel. The whipped texture glides effortlessly over the skin, releasing a bright and fruity pomegranate fragrance for a refreshing shower experience. With every use, your skin is left smoother, radiant, and revitalized.

Key Features:

Gentle Exfoliation: Removes dull, dry skin without harshness

Deep Nourishment: Infused with ¼ moisturising cream

Luxurious Texture: Whipped, creamy formula for easy application

Refreshing Scent: Fruity pomegranate aroma for an uplifting shower

Visible Results: Reveals softer, smoother skin after every use

Net Volume: 225ml
Skin Type: Suitable for all skin type
